name: apache/casbin
description: Apache Casbin is an open-source authorization library supporting access control models including ACL, RBAC, and ABAC, with implementations in Go, Java, Python, Node.js, Rust, and more. Used widely as a policy enforcement engine in applications.
score_rationale: Industry-standard authorization and policy enforcement library with 19.9k stars, Apache-backed, and multi-language implementations used in production across thousands of projects.
summary: Apache Casbin is an open-source authorization library supporting access control models including ACL
